explanation: Where filters elements greater than 2; returns 3, 4, 5 (count = 3).
Where is lazy; predicate only executes when ToList() materializes the query.
Select transforms each element; 1 * 2 = 2, result is [2, 4, 6].
OrderBy sorts ascending; smallest element 1 is first.
First with predicate returns first element matching condition; 3 > 2.
Any returns true if any element matches; no element > 5, so false.
Distinct removes duplicates; unique elements are 1, 2, 3 (count = 3).
GroupBy groups by key; three distinct keys (1, 2, 3) create three groups.
Join finds matching elements; 2 and 3 appear in both, returning pairs count.
